_readme.purpose: Standing catalyst calendar. Holds dated events the earnings API does NOT provide: investor/analyst days, conferences, product launches, sales/delivery reports, FDA action dates, splits, shareholder meetings, filing deadlines, and macro speaking events. Routine earnings are pulled live from the earnings calendar and do not belong here.
consumed_by: daily premarket report - today's entries feed the game plan, next 5 days feed the This Week EVENTS column
Sunday week-ahead page - full following-week view
rules: time is 12-hour Central Time, or null when only the date is known
verified=true requires a real source URL; verified=false renders as tentative, never as fact
never add an entry without a source - omit it instead
_readme.fields: ticker | name | type | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | time_ct | note | source | verified

events.name: Apple
events.note: WATCH DATE, not the event. Apple has confirmed to retail staff that its iPhone event lands in the first half of September; on its four-year pattern the invitation goes out exactly two weeks prior, making 8/26 the likely announcement date. Event itself most likely Sept 8 or 9. iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and a first foldable expected.

events.name: NVIDIA
events.note: Q2 FY2027. Results expected ~1:20pm PT (3:20pm CT), conference call 2:00pm PT (4:00pm CT). CFO written commentary posts immediately after the results release. Lands the day BEFORE Jackson Hole opens. Stored here despite being earnings because the earnings API carries no times.

events.name: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium
events.note: Runs Aug 27-29 (Thu-Sat) at Jackson Lake Lodge. 2026 theme: 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy.' Powell's speech is NOT yet scheduled or confirmed - the KC Fed does not publish the agenda or speaker list until shortly before the event. Historically the Chair speaks Friday morning, which would be Aug 28. CORRECTION: an earlier entry had this as Aug 22 based on the FlowMS newsletter; the KC Fed date is Aug 27-29.
